args.body:
Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brought mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your email up front makes you easy to reach. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as projects, interests or a portfolio, plus some visuals and clear navigation. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. The personal touch about hiking comes through. To improve it, you could add posts with trail stories, photos, and tips, and maybe a way for readers to subscribe or comment. Great start!

final_text:
